name: com.alohalabshq/dial
title: Dial by Aloha Labs
description: Phone numbers for AI agents: get a number, read texted verification codes, place AI voice calls.

tools.name: sign_up
tools.description: Create your own Dial account. Use an email inbox you can read: a confirmation link is sent there and must be opened before you can get a number. Returns your api_key ONCE. Store it somewhere permanent and pass it to the other tools.

email.description: An email address you can read

invite_code.description: Invite code (required during the private beta)

tools.name: get_phone_number
tools.description: Get a phone number for this agent. Returns your existing number if you already have one, otherwise provisions a new one. Use it when a website or service asks for a phone number.

force_new.description: Provision another number even if one exists

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers this account owns.

tools.name: wait_for_verification_code
tools.description: Wait for a verification code (OTP) texted to one of your numbers and return it. Call this right after a site says it sent you a code. Each code is returned once.

service.description: Only accept codes from this sender, e.g. 'google'

tools.name: read_text_messages
tools.description: Read recent text messages received on one of your numbers.

tools.name: release_phone_number
tools.description: Give up a phone number you no longer need. You will stop receiving texts on it.

tools.name: make_phone_call
tools.description: Have an AI voice assistant phone a business or person for your human, from your Dial number: book a table, make an appointment, ask a question. It introduces itself as an AI assistant calling on behalf of your human, works toward the goal, and stays within your limits; anything outside them it notes for a callback. Returns a call id at once. Then call get_call_result to wait for the outcome, summary and transcript. US and Canadian numbers only; one call at a time.

number_id.description: id of your number (from get_phone_number); the call comes from it

goal.description: What the call should achieve, e.g. 'Book a table for 2 this Saturday at 7pm'

details.description: Facts the assistant may share: reservation name, party size, a callback number, preferences

may_agree_to.description: Limits, e.g. 'any time 6:30-8:30pm; no deposit'. Without this it agrees only to exactly the goal.

voice.description: Voice persona from list_voices, e.g. 'brian' (calm male) or 'sarah' (warm female). 'male'/'female' also work.

assistant_name.description: Your own first name; the call opens 'Hi, this is <name>, an AI assistant calling for <human>'

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the voices you can use on calls, each with its gender, accent and personality. Pass the id as make_phone_call's voice.

tools.name: get_call_result
tools.description: Get the result of a call from make_phone_call: status, outcome, summary and transcript. Waits up to wait_seconds for the call to finish; if it's still going, call again.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the call to end (default 90)

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recent calls, newest first. Use direction 'inbound' to read calls people made to your number: the AI answers them, takes a message, and the summary and transcript are here.

direction.description: 'inbound' = calls to your number (messages); 'outbound' = calls you placed

tools.name: set_call_answering
tools.description: Set how the AI answers when someone calls your number. It always says it's an AI assistant and takes a message; these settings personalize it.

owner_name.description: Your human's name, e.g. 'Berk'. The greeting says '<assistant>, <owner>'s AI assistant'

instructions.description: Extra guidance, e.g. 'If it's about the Capri booking, ask for their confirmation number.'

tools.name: resend_confirmation_email
tools.description: Send a new email-confirmation link to your account's address (if the first one expired or got lost).

tools.name: start_subscription
tools.description: Get a Stripe Checkout link for a monthly plan. starter is $15 (1 number, 100 call minutes, 400 SMS), pro is $49 (5 numbers, 250 minutes, 1,000 SMS), scale is $179 (20 numbers, 1,000 minutes, 5,000 SMS). Your human can enter a promotion code on the page. Extra minutes are $0.15, extra numbers $2, extra SMS $0.015. Give the link to your human.

plan.description: starter ($15), pro ($49) or scale ($179). Default starter.

tools.name: manage_billing
tools.description: Get a Stripe Customer Portal session URL. Your human opens it to update the card, switch between Starter, Pro and Scale, or cancel. Returns { url }.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Show your plan, limits, free credit and billing status, whether your email is confirmed, and texts received this month.
